name: Kozushima (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Kozushima village emblem in white: a ring crossed by a stylised swirl with horizontal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Kozushima, a village in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 11 January 1978.

features.role: Kozushima village emblem — a ring crossed by a stylised swirl with horizontal strokes
